segment_captions.caption: C opens a blue container and takes out a piece of cloth from it.
C places a blue cloth into the washing machine. The washing machine door is open, and C's hands are positioned inside the machine. A green bucket is visible next to the washing machine.
C opens the washing machine lid with their right hand while holding a green bucket with their left hand.
C picks up a green bucket from the floor next to a washing machine and walks towards a pile of clothes on the floor, preparing to collect laundry.
C picks up a piece of cloth from the floor and places it into a bucket.
C opens the washing machine door with their right hand while holding a piece of cloth in their left hand.
C picks up a broom from the floor and begins sweeping the area around the washing machine.
C picks up a broom from the floor and begins sweeping the area near the wall.
C walks towards a bed with clothes scattered around, then bends down to pick up a pink item from the floor.
C adjusts the curtain with their right hand while sitting on the bed covered with a floral-patterned blanket and a pink cloth. A white cat is lying nearby on the bed.
C adjusts the curtain with their right hand while sitting on the bed.
C walks towards the bed, adjusting the curtain with their right hand.
C picks up a blue pen from a notebook on the floor.
C picks up a blue marker from the floor and walks towards a door, opening it slightly with their right hand.

C picks up a small object from the floor with their right hand while holding a tool in their left hand. The object appears to be a piece of paper or a small card. C then moves towards a door, opening it slightly with their right hand.
C picks up a piece of cloth from the floor and places it on a table covered with various items.
C picks up a spoon from the countertop and stirs food in a pan on the stove. The countertop has a plate of green peas and other kitchen items like a kettle and a blue cup.
C walks towards the door while holding a cup of water.
C walks towards a bucket of water, picks up a white cup from the floor, and places it into the bucket.
C pours water from a bucket into a cup held by their left hand while standing near a tiled floor.
C places a white bowl inside a larger orange bowl on the floor, then adjusts the bowls slightly.
C places a bowl into a larger container, then walks towards a kitchen counter where another person is preparing food.
C picks up a small blue container from the counter while the other person continues to handle food items on the stove.
C picks up a green vegetable from a bowl with her left hand while holding a small container in her right hand. Another person in the background stirs food in a pan with a wooden spoon.
C picks up a small bowl from the counter and places it back down, adjusting its position slightly.
C picks up a blue bowl from the counter and places it back down, adjusting its position slightly.
C picks up a blue container from the countertop and places it back down next to a bowl of green vegetables.
C places a blue container on the countertop next to a plate of green peas and a pot of food on the stove.
C picks up a bowl of spices from the counter and adds them to the pot on the stove with a wooden spoon.
C opens a container and pours its contents into a pot on the stove, stirring the mixture with a wooden spoon.
C places the green lid on the pot containing corn kernels after stirring them with a wooden spoon.
C opens a jar with a green lid and pours its contents into a pot on the stove, stirring the mixture with a wooden spatula.
C pours a green substance from a container into a pot of food while stirring with chopsticks.
C pours water from a green bowl into a pot of vegetables on the stove while stirring with chopsticks.
C picks up a small bowl from the counter and places it back down while stirring the food in the pot with chopsticks.
C stirs food in a pan with a wooden spoon while holding a small bowl in the other hand.
C stirs food in a pan with a spatula, then lifts the pan off the stove.
C picks up a pot lid from the stove and places it on the counter next to a container of green peas.
C pours water from a metal container into a bowl on the table, then places the container back on the table.
C picks up a frying pan from the stove and holds it with both hands, preparing to move it.
C places a pot on the stove and picks up a bowl of green peas from the counter.
C picks up a metal container from the countertop and places it back down next to a bowl of green peas.
C picks up a pot lid from the table and places it on the stove. The pot lid is metallic and shiny. C then moves a small metal container towards the stove, possibly to pour its contents into the pot.
C picks up a metal cup from the table and places it next to a plate of green peas.
C picks up a wooden spoon from the countertop and stirs the food in the pot on the stove.
